## 3\. Hitsujiyama Park in Saitama - A Dream in Pink and Purple

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49130.webp)

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of 350,000 shibazakura (moss phlox flowers) at **Hitsujiyama Park** in Saitama! The colorful shibazakura are arranged in various layouts forming special designs on the ground.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49110.webp)

At the foot of Chichibu’s symbolic mountain, Mount Buko, the **Shibazakura Festival** is held every year from mid-April to early May where you can enjoy the spectacular floral garden alongside tasty local food.

![Hitsujiyama Park](https://place.matcha-jp.com/resize/200x2000/2024/03/25-16-57-36-1997e97f9c2b3ee92714a5d7aafca6ac41aa.webp)

Hitsujiyama Park

6360 Omiya, Chichibu City, Saitama Prefecture 368-0023

Hitsujiyama Park is a park where you can enjoy beautiful scenery throughout the four seasons. The natural beauty that changes with the seasons, such as cherry blossoms, moss phlox, and autumn leaves, is attractive. In particular, the moss phlox hill is at its best from late April to early May, and you can enjoy the spectacular scenery.

## 4\. Showa Kinen Park - A Colorful View in Tokyo

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49111.webp)

**Showa Kinen Park** is located on the outskirts of Tokyo. It is a national park that presents a variety of activities and stunning sceneries throughout the year. During spring, you can appreciate the beauty of nature by witnessing a great variety of spring flowers.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49112.webp)

The national park is huge and well equipped with restaurants, cafes, and even a sports area. Apart from the impressive greenery, you can also explore the traditional Japanese garden and a bonsai exhibition.

[Book a Cherry Blossom Tour of Tokyo's Best Gardens](https://www.klook.com/en-US/activity/145407-cherry-blossom-day-trip-showa-kinen-rikugien-asukayama-from-tokyo/?aid=3414)

![Showa Kinen Park](https://place.matcha-jp.com/resize/200x2000/2022/09/13-19-47-04-1155f8bdfa2875d328f8e13535cc9bee.webp)

Showa Kinen Park

3173 Midoricho, Tachikawa, Tokyo

Showa Kinen Park is a national park that opened in 1983. It straddles Akishima and Tachikawa cities on the outskirts of Tokyo.

The park is home to a variety of facilities, including a cultural center, a cafe, a Japanese garden, a dog run, a grassy plain, and a barbecue garden, and is visited by many people throughout the year.

You can experience the changing seasons through the flowers that bloom, such as cherry blossoms and tulips in spring, hydrangeas and sunflowers in summer, and cosmos in autumn.

## 5\. Kameido Tenjinja Shrine in Tokyo - Encounter Beautiful Wisteria

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49114.webp)

Do you know that apart from sakura, the wisteria is another representative spring flower in Japan? Wisteria, also known as the ‘fuji no hana’, is a long trailing flower that presents itself in a vivid lavender color.

**Kameido Tenjinja** (Kameido Shrine), located near the Tokyo Skytree, is the best spot to view wisterias in the capital city.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49113.webp)

The purple wisteria hanging from trellises with the Japanese-style arched bridge in the background creates a unique view of spring. Over one hundred wisterias bloom during the annual Fuji Festival which is held from mid-April to early May.

## 6\. Fuji Shibazakura Festival - Mount Fuji Framed in Pink

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49116.webp)

From mid-April to the end of May, a splendid view of shibazakura at the foot of **Mount Fuji** can be viewed from **Kawaguchiko** in Yamanashi prefecture. The extensive field of Shibazakura here is one of the largest in the greater Tokyo area, embracing about 800,000 shibazakura in various colors.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49117.webp)

You can also encounter various food stalls around the area featuring local dishes and tasty treats that always accompany festivals. Enjoy the fabulous view while enjoying delicious food!

## 7\. Hamamatsu Flower Park in Shizuoka - Great Variety of Spring Flowers

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49118.webp)

Located at the edge of Lake Hamana in Shizuoka, **Hamamatsu Flower Park** has 3000 types of flowers that bloom at various times around the year. Spring flowers such as azaleas, tulips, roses, wisteria and hydrangea bloom shortly after the cherry trees.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49119.webp)

There is a large greenhouse situated at the center of the park showcasing rare and seasonal plants. For only 100 yen you can get on the ‘Flower Train’ and enjoy a ride around the park!

![Hamamatsu Flower Park](https://place.matcha-jp.com/resize/200x2000/2022/07/08-10-18-04-d6ae4a3f7ad0dceedc1194637ec9a4a6.webp)

Hamamatsu Flower Park

195 Kanzanji-cho, Nishi-ku, Hamamatsu-shi, Shizuoka 431-1209

In the vast 300,000 square meter garden, you can enjoy 3,000 kinds of plants that change with the seasons, including cherry blossoms, tulips, wisteria, roses, irises, plum blossoms, and seasonal flowers. The bright and clear Crystal Palace greenhouse, the Great Fountain Show where water dances in time with music, and the Flower Train, a sightseeing ride that runs through the garden, are also popular. The garden is also open at night during the cherry blossom, wisteria, and Christmas seasons.
Winner of the 16th Shizuoka Prefecture Urban Landscape Award Grand Prize (Japan Institute of Architects Shizuoka Regional Association Award).

## 8\. Mount Ikoma Narukawa Azalea Garden in Osaka - A Trip Back to Nature

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49121.webp)

If you are hoping to get away from the busy pace of the city and return to nature, a day trip to the Kongo-Ikoma-Kisen Quasi-National Park in **Osaka** will be an ideal option for you!

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49122.webp)

The beautiful Narukawa Azalea Garden is hidden in the mountains and can only be reached on foot. You will be overwhelmed by the vibrant color of azaleas which grow in bushes that are higher than yourself!

There are also other flower gardens, a barbeque space and an amusement park within this national park. You will most surely enjoy exploring this secret floral garden!

Fumin no Mori Narukawa Garden

## 9\. Kuju Flower Park in Oita - Flowers As Far As The Eye Can See

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49125.webp)

Located on the Kuju Plateau in Taketa city in **Oita**, **Kuju Flower Park** has a greenhouse and spacious fields featuring seasonal flowers of more than 500 varieties for most of the year, except winter.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49123.webp)

During spring, you will be able to enjoy the blossoming of tulips, shibazakura, pansies, poppies, and nemophila. The backdrop of Mount Kuju over the colorful flower field will definitely make for an unforgettable memory!

![Kuju Flower Park](https://place.matcha-jp.com/resize/200x2000/2024/04/12-19-58-58-2496c368cba5f076f16a72135f7a2cb58a70.webp)

Kuju Flower Park

878-0201 4050 Kusumi, Kusumi-cho, Taketa City, Oita Prefecture

Kuju Flower Park is located in Aso Kuju National Park, where you can enjoy 500 varieties and 5 million flowers throughout the year. At an altitude of 850m and covering an area of ​​225,000㎡, the vast park offers not only seasonal flowers but also the majestic mountain scenery. You can also enjoy the beautiful starry sky at night, so you can enjoy the flowers and stars from day to night. There are various hot spring resorts nearby, so after enjoying the flowers, you can visit the wonderful hot springs and heal your mind and body. In addition, the ruins of Oka Castle, a nationally designated historic site said to be an impregnable castle, and the castle town are nearby, making it an area where you can experience history and culture. After experiencing the seasonal flowers and majestic nature at Kuju Flower Park, you can visit hot springs in the surrounding area, experience history, culture, and rich food.

## 10\. Nokonoshima Island Park - Fukuoka's Stunning Floral Garden

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49126.webp)

Situated on an island, Fukuoka's Nokonoshima Island Park is surrounded by greenery and the ocean. The beautiful flower fields in this park attract thousands of visitors throughout the year.

![10 Best spots to view spring flowers around Japan ](https://resources.matcha-jp.com/resize/720x2000/2018/02/26-49127.webp)

The blossoming of rapeseed, sakura, daisies, and marigold will offer an amazing sight of spring. During a particular time of the year, which is usually announced beforehand by the park, visitors are welcome to pick flowers as long as they pay the entrance fee. Wouldn’t it be nice to bring a bunch of beautiful flowers back to your room?

## FAQ

### What is the famous spring flower in Japan?

The famous spring flower in Japan is the cherry blossom, known as "sakura" in Japanese. Cherry blossoms hold great cultural significance in Japan and are celebrated during the annual tradition of hanami, which involves viewing and appreciating the beauty of cherry blossoms in bloom. These delicate and transient flowers symbolize the ephemeral nature of life and are admired for their stunning displays of pink and white petals covering trees across the country. The sakura season, typically in March to early April, is a highly anticipated time in Japan, attracting locals and tourists alike to witness this breathtaking natural spectacle.

### What is the famous flower park in Japan?

One of the most famous and picturesque flower parks in Japan is Ashikaga Flower Park in Tochigi Prefecture. This renowned park is celebrated for its awe-inspiring displays of wisteria blossoms, including the iconic Great Wisteria with its cascading blooms in various hues. Visitors are enchanted by the ethereal beauty of these floral tunnels and trellises, especially during the peak blooming season from late April to early May. Ashikaga Flower Park's wisteria spectacles, coupled with its serene ambiance and meticulously landscaped gardens, make it a top destination for nature enthusiasts and flower aficionados seeking a mesmerizing floral experience in Japan.

### What month do flowers bloom in Japan?

Flowers bloom in Japan throughout the year, with each season showcasing different blooms and colors. The cherry blossoms, or sakura, typically bloom in spring, usually from late March to early April, depending on the region and the specific type of cherry tree. This period marks the highly anticipated sakura season, when people gather for hanami (flower viewing) to celebrate the fleeting beauty of the cherry blossoms. Other flowers bloom during different seasons in Japan: summer features hydrangeas and irises, autumn showcases chrysanthemums and colored leaves, and winter displays camellias and plum blossoms. Japan's diverse climate and landscape offer a rich tapestry of blooming flowers throughout the year, contributing to the country's vibrant floral culture.

### Where to see cherry blossoms in April in Japan?

In April, visitors in Japan can continue to appreciate the beauty of cherry blossoms (sakura) as the bloom progresses from south to north across the country. Regions such as Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kansai, Chubu, and Kyushu offer opportunities to see cherry blossoms in April. In Hokkaido, cities like Hakodate and Sapporo may still feature cherry blossoms in early to mid-April due to the cooler climate. The Tohoku region showcases late-blooming cherry blossoms in places like Hirosaki Castle in Aomori and Kakunodate in Akita. In the Kansai region, Kyoto and Nara provide picturesque spots such as Maruyama Park and Nara Park for cherry blossom viewing. Additionally, the Chubu region offers scenic locations like Takayama and Nagoya's Yamazakigawa Riverside, while Kyushu's Fukuoka and Kumamoto regions are also known for cherry blossoms that bloom later into April. These diverse regions showcase the enduring charm of cherry blossoms, allowing visitors to enjoy their beauty well into the month of April.

### What are the three most famous gardens in Japan?

Kenrokuen in Kanazawa, Korakuen in Okayama, and the Katsura Imperial Villa in Kyoto are three of Japan's most renowned gardens, each celebrated for their distinctive beauty, historical significance, and meticulous design. Kenrokuen, one of the Three Great Gardens of Japan, embodies the six attributes of a perfect garden and features scenic ponds and teahouses. Korakuen, another of the Three Great Gardens, combines Japanese and Chinese garden elements, offering tranquil vistas and cultural richness. The Katsura Imperial Villa in Kyoto showcases exquisite Japanese garden design and architectural harmony, reflecting simplicity, tranquility, and elegance. These gardens stand as iconic destinations that capture the essence and artistry of traditional Japanese garden landscapes.

### What are the 3 national flowers of Japan?

Cherry blossom (sakura), chrysanthemum (kiku), and Japanese apricot (ume) are the three national flowers of Japan, each carrying distinct meanings and symbolism in Japanese culture. The cherry blossom is celebrated for its representation of the fleeting nature of life and the beauty of spring, epitomized in hanami traditions and poetic reflections. Chrysanthemums symbolize longevity, nobility, and the Imperial Family, featuring prominently in art and imperial crests. Japanese apricots, known for blooming in late winter, signify endurance, elegance, and the transition of seasons, embodying virtues like purity and patience in Japanese traditions. Together, these national flowers reflect Japan's deep-rooted connections to nature, beauty, tradition, and national identity.

### When to see wisteria in Japan?

Wisteria blooms in Japan typically occur during the spring season, with the peak bloom period varying depending on the region and climate. In general, wisteria flowers can be seen from late April to early May in many parts of Japan, including popular wisteria viewing locations like Ashikaga Flower Park in Tochigi Prefecture and Kawachi Fuji Gardens in Kitakyushu. These stunning floral displays attract visitors from around the world who come to witness the breathtaking beauty of cascading wisteria blossoms in various colors and settings. Timing your visit to coincide with the peak bloom period ensures you experience the wisteria in full splendor, creating a memorable and enchanting floral spectacle in Japan.

## Get Ready for Spring!

The cherry blossoms can be seen in bloom for an exceptionally short period of time and it may be hard to catch it during your stay in Japan. But don’t worry, there are other types of spring flowers in Japan that are just as charming as the cherry blossoms. Why not explore these floral gardens and see what else does Japan has to offer in spring?

### No.01 Kitagawa Village "Monet's Garden" Marmottan (Kochi Prefecture)

![北川村「モネの庭」マルモッタン](https://www.club-t.com/ct/kanko/guide/kokunai/info/k_221/k_221_001.jpg)

Kitagawa Village "Monet's Garden" Marmottan

Monet's Garden Marmottan in Kitagawa Village is modeled after the garden of Giverny, France, beloved by the impressionist painter Claude Monet. The garden has been officially granted the name "Monet's Garden," which was previously kept secret. Utilizing the undulating terrain, areas recreating Monet's paintings are scattered throughout the garden. With colorful water lilies, rose arches, flowers of all seasons, arched bridges, and wisteria trellises reflected on the surface of the pond, it's truly a painting-like landscape. Another highlight is the zone that depicts the Mediterranean world that Monet used as a subject, using the scenery of Kochi's sea and mountains. There are also walking paths and a playground, so you can enjoy the garden all day long.

Basic Information

■Recommended seasons

Late Apr. ~ Late Oct.

■Location

■Access by train

### No.02 Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden (Kochi Prefecture)

![高知県立牧野植物園 （イメージ）](https://www.club-t.com/ct/kanko/guide/kokunai/info/k_221/k_221_002.jpg)

Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden (Image)

This botanical garden honors the achievements of Dr. Tomitaro Makino, who was featured as a model for a TV drama and was said to be the "father of plant taxonomy in Japan." The Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden, which covers an area of about 8 hectares, grows more than 3,000 species of plants, including wild and horticultural plants. At the Tomitaro Makino Memorial Hall, which has an exhibition about the doctor, the building that has won numerous architectural awards is also a highlight. The greenhouse where tropical plants are grown is symbolized by the 9-meter green tower standing at the entrance. The design is Image a large wooden cave, and plants such as ferns and red flowers cover the inside of the tower.

### No.03 Hamamatsu Flower Park (Shizuoka Prefecture)

![はままつフラワーパーク（イメージ）](https://www.club-t.com/ct/kanko/guide/kokunai/info/k_221/k_221_003.jpg)

Hamamatsu Flower Park (Image)

The approximately 300,000-square-meter park is filled with a variety of flowers throughout the four seasons, including a fountain and surrounding flower beds, a large greenhouse, a rose garden, a row of cherry blossom trees, a plum orchard, and a flower garden. It is also the main venue for the annual "Lake Hamana Flower Festa", and the garden where cherry blossoms and tulips compete is a specialty of Hamatsu Flower Park. Apr. From the end of the month onwards, you can see the fantastic scenery of the Fuji Shelf of about 150 meters. In addition, the park is open at night during the cherry blossom season and Christmas season, making it a flower theme park that you can never run out.

Basic Information

■Recommended seasons

Late Jan. ~ early May.

■Location

Gifu World Rose Garden is a rose garden with approximately 20,000 rose bushes of approximately 6,000 varieties planted on an area the size of 17 Nagoya Domes. metadata.description: Club Tourism brings you a paradise of beautiful flowers and trees that you want to go to at least once! In the 30 best gardens and flowers in Japan, Kitagawa Village "Monet's Garden" Marmottan (Kochi Prefecture), Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden (Kochi Prefecture), Hamamatsu Flower Park (Shizuoka Prefecture), Lake Hamana Garden Park (Shizuoka Prefecture), Gardening Museum Flower Garden, Tokachi Hills [Hokkaido Garden], Ueno Farm [Hokkaido Garden], Rokka Forest [Hokkaido Garden], Wind Garden [Hokkaido Garden], Manabe Garden [Hokkaido Garden], Tokachi Millennium Forest [Hokkaido Garden], Shichiku Garden [Hokkaido Garden], Taisetsu Forest Garden [Hokkaido Garden], Yoshokuen (Hokkaido), Nakanojo Gardens (Gunma Prefecture), Echigo Hillside Park (Niigata), Hattori Farm (Kanagawa), Tateshina Kogen Balakline English Garden (Nagano), Yatsugatake Club (Yamanashi), Karuizawa Taliasen (Nagano), Karuizawa Lake Garden (Nagano Prefecture), Rosenberry Tawada (Shiga Prefecture), Harayaen Garden (Kyoto Prefecture), Suzuka Forest Garden (Mie Prefecture), Red Hill　Heather Forest (Mie Prefecture), Gifu World Rose Garden (Gifu Prefecture), Kazahaya Village (Mie Prefecture), Nabana Village (Mie Prefecture), Sera Kogen Farm (Hiroshima Prefecture), Florante Miyazaki (Miyazaki Prefecture), and other useful information that you should check out before you go on a trip!, クラブツーリズムがお届けする一度は行きたい美しい花々と樹木の楽園！全国のガーデン・花名所30選では、北川村「モネの庭」マルモッタン（高知県）、高知県立牧野植物園（高知県）、はままつフラワーパーク（静岡県）、浜名湖ガーデンパーク（静岡県）、ガーデニングミュージアム　花遊庭、十勝ヒルズ【北海道ガーデン】、上野ファーム【北海道ガーデン】、六花の森【北海道ガーデン】、風のガーデン【北海道ガーデン】、真鍋庭園【北海道ガーデン】、十勝千年の森【北海道ガーデン】、紫竹ガーデン【北海道ガーデン】、大雪 森のガーデン【北海道ガーデン】、陽殖園（北海道）、中之条ガーデンズ（群馬県）、国立越後丘陵公園（新潟県）、服部牧場（神奈川県）、蓼科高原 バラクライングリッシュガーデン（長野県）、八ヶ岳倶楽部（山梨県）、軽井沢タリアセン（長野県） 、軽井沢レイクガーデン（長野県）、ローザンベリー多和田（滋賀県）、原谷苑（京都府）、鈴鹿の森庭園（三重県）、レッドヒル　ヒーサーの森（三重県）、ぎふワールド・ローズガーデン（岐阜県）、かざはやの里（三重県）、なばなの里（三重県）、世羅高原農場（広島県）、フローランテ宮崎（宮崎県）など、旅に出る前に見ておきたいお役立ち情報が満載！
